dataset = xsiam_socfw_ir_execution_raw
| filter execution_mode = "shadow"
| alter t_ms = to_epoch(_time, "millis")
| alter t_verdict = if(event_type = "analysis_complete", t_ms, null)
| comp min(t_ms) as first_ms, min(t_verdict) as verdict_ms by incident_id
| filter verdict_ms != null
| alter d_ms = subtract(verdict_ms, first_ms)
| filter d_ms >= 0
| alter mttd_seconds = divide(d_ms, 1000)
| comp avg(mttd_seconds) as avg_mttd_sec
| view graph type = single subtype = standard header = "MTTD (sec)" yaxis = avg_mttd_sec

dataset = xsiam_socfw_ir_execution_raw

| alter t_verdict = if(event_type = "analysis_complete", t_ms, null)
| comp max(t_first) as first_ms, max(t_verdict) as verdict_ms by incident_id
| filter verdict_ms != null and first_ms != null
| alter mtti_ms = subtract(verdict_ms, first_ms)

| alter mtti_minutes = divide(mtti_ms, 60000)
| comp avg(mtti_minutes) as avg_mtti_min
| view graph type = single subtype = standard yaxis = avg_mtti_min

widgets_data.title: Cases AI Would Auto-Close (Shadow)
widgets_data.description: Cases the AI close decision judged closeable. Shadow-safe: counts would_close, not did_close.

data.phrase:

| filter event_type = "ai_close_decision"
| filter would_close = true
| comp count_distinct(incident_id) as cases
| view graph type = single subtype = standard header = "Cases AI Would Auto-Close" yaxis = cases

widgets_data.title: MTTD (sec)
widgets_data.description: Ingest to assessment verdict. Producer-agnostic: any Assess output, AI or rule-based.

data.phrase:
dataset = xsiam_socfw_ir_execution_raw
| alter t_ms = to_epoch(_time, "millis")
| alter t_verdict = if(uppercase(phase) = "ASSESSMENT", t_ms, null)
| comp min(t_ms) as first_ms, min(t_verdict) as verdict_ms by incident_id
| filter verdict_ms != null
| alter d_ms = subtract(verdict_ms, first_ms)
| filter d_ms >= 0
| alter mttd_seconds = divide(d_ms, 1000)
| comp avg(mttd_seconds) as avg_mttd_sec
| view graph type = single subtype = standard header = "MTTD (sec)" yaxis = avg_mttd_sec

widgets_data.title: MTTI (min)
widgets_data.description: Last investigation command to assessment verdict, in minutes. Max-based: the final enrichment or analysis command, not the first. Producer-agnostic verdict anchor.

data.phrase:
dataset = xsiam_socfw_ir_execution_raw
| alter t_ms = to_epoch(_time, "millis")
| alter t_first = if(event_type = "command" and uppercase(phase) in ("ANALYSIS","ENRICHMENT"), t_ms, null)
| alter t_verdict = if(uppercase(phase) = "ASSESSMENT", t_ms, null)
| comp max(t_first) as first_ms, max(t_verdict) as verdict_ms by incident_id
| filter verdict_ms != null and first_ms != null
| alter mtti_ms = subtract(verdict_ms, first_ms)
| filter mtti_ms > 0
| alter mtti_minutes = divide(mtti_ms, 60000)
| comp avg(mtti_minutes) as avg_mtti_min
| view graph type = single subtype = standard header = "MTTI (min)" yaxis = avg_mtti_min

widgets_data.title: MTTC (min)
widgets_data.description: Ingest to containment, in minutes. Counts planned and shadowed containment, not only executed.

data.phrase:
dataset = xsiam_socfw_ir_execution_raw
| alter t_ms = to_epoch(_time, "millis")
| alter t_stage = if(uppercase(phase) = "CONTAINMENT", t_ms, null)
| comp min(t_ms) as first_ms, min(t_stage) as stage_ms by incident_id
| filter stage_ms != null
| alter d_ms = subtract(stage_ms, first_ms)
| filter d_ms >= 0
| alter avg_mttc_min_val = divide(d_ms, 60000)
| comp avg(avg_mttc_min_val) as avg_mttc_min
| view graph type = single subtype = standard header = "MTTC (min)" yaxis = avg_mttc_min
